evals.name: review-without-editing
evals.prompt: Review the marina .play model before acceptance. Report findings; do not touch the model.
evals.expected_output: A critic-mode report: scope and source identity, V1 to V5 lines each a result or 'not run: reason', element sweep, entity walk, findings pinned to one declaration with severity, kind, rule, consequence and fix, and a verdict. Edit requests go to the owning session; no model file changes.
assertions: Every finding names exactly one declaration or an explicit list, never 'several' or a wildcard.
All five verdict lines are present as a result or 'not run: <reason>'.
Fixes are returned as edit requests and no model file is changed.
Defects and business questions are in separate lists.

evals.name: impact-walkthrough
evals.prompt: We want to record the boat insurer before a berth can be assigned. Walk me through what changes in the model. Do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: An impact walkthrough: a summary with the slice count split into existing, changed and new; one step per slice in run order with status, business-word description, rules from specifications and changes lines; a sketch for each new slice labeled as a proposal; unmodeled behavior reported as open questions, not rules. Ends with the proposal and offers edit requests for the modeler.
assertions: Opens with a count split by existing, changed and new slices.
Uses one step per slice, not per element, and every step has a status.
Every changed step has changes and every new step has a sketch marked as a proposal.
States gaps as open questions, never as rules, and does not edit the model.

evals.name: explain-feature
evals.prompt: How does berth booking work? I cannot read .play.
evals.expected_output: An explain walkthrough: summary and a few sentences, then the feature's slices in the order a person lives them, in business words with rules taken from specifications. Chosen by the subject being modeled, read-only.
assertions: Chooses explain mode because the subject is already modeled.
Writes one step per slice in run order using business words without declaration addresses in the text.
Takes rules only from specifications and marks anything unmodeled as an open question.

evals.name: inventory-and-journey
evals.prompt: Give me a read-only inventory of this inherited model and then trace where the owner's email goes.
evals.expected_output: An inventory in the fixed shape (modules, elements, assertion coverage with the slices lacking one, structural gaps, orphans, summary) and a single-property journey with a headline and a table of roles: enters, recorded, changed, used, leaves, traced through property links with incomplete results named.
assertions: Reports counts and assertion coverage as n of total with a percentage and names slices with none.
Traces one piece of information with the property-link roles and names incomplete or opaque links.
Gives a headline counting where it enters, is recorded and is used.
Makes no change to the model.
